remarks: Come experience city living at its finest. Located in the mid city neighborhood of Stamford, this stunning and desirable unit is walking distance to restaurants, shopping and more. Open floor concept on the main level makes this unit wonderful for entertaining and easy everyday living. Updated kitchen boasting stainless steel appliances and beautiful, spacious quartz countertops with plenty of cabinetry. Half bath, dining room and living room with gas fireplace to cozy up on chilly nights complete the main level. The second level has been completely updated with hardwood flooring. Upstairs you'll find two spacious bedrooms. Primary bedroom provides plenty of natural light. It has two large closets and a full bathroom with double sinks. Second bedroom, another full bathroom, laundry and loft complete the second level. LG washer and dryer on the second floor next to the bedrooms makes it very convenient to get laundry done. Loft can very easily be used as an office or home gym. Complex has elevator that takes you down to the covered garage where there is one assigned space. Second assigned parking space is in the rear lot outside. Make your appointment today and enjoy everything the beautiful city of Stamford has to offer.
